# DMC Turkey Partner — full content

> DmcTurkeyPartner.com is a Turkey-based destination management company (DMC) and local execution partner for international agencies, MICE planners, incentive houses and group travel buyers. Services cover hotel sourcing, venue sourcing, transportation & logistics, event production, ground handling, incentive programs, meetings & conferences and white-label DMC support, across Istanbul, Antalya, Belek, Bodrum and Cappadocia.

## DMC Turkey | Destination Management Company & Local Partner
URL: https://dmcturkeypartner.com/dmc-turkey/


## DMC Turkey — Your Local Execution Partner
DMC Turkey Partner is a destination management company operating in Turkey since 2006. We execute MICE programmes, incentive trips, corporate events and group travel for international agencies, incentive houses and PCOs across Istanbul, Antalya, Belek, Cappadocia and Bodrum — handling accommodation, ground transport, venue sourcing, event production and on-site coordination.

### What Does a DMC in Turkey Handle?
A local Destination Management Company coordinates the on-the-ground components of a project or group program. This typically covers accommodation sourcing, transportation, venue sourcing, meetings, events, group logistics, experiences, suppliers, production, staffing and on-site coordination — managed locally so the international agency does not have to coordinate each supplier directly.

#### How Our Local Delivery Model Fits
Aspect Our local delivery model Travel agency services PCO services
Typical clients Agencies, corporations and PCOs Leisure, business and group travellers Conference organisers and associations
Focus Local programme delivery — hotels, transport, venues and production Travel planning, bookings and packaged services Congress planning, programme and delegate coordination
Service scope Defined by your brief and agreed delivery responsibilities Varies by provider and project; local delivery may be included Varies by congress scope; local delivery may be coordinated with partners

### One Local Partner for Your Turkey Operations
Rather than coordinating multiple disconnected local suppliers, the overseas agency can work through one central operational structure covering accommodation, transportation, venues, production, activities, staffing, suppliers, logistics and on-site operations.

### Our DMC Services in Turkey

#### Hotel Sourcing
Hotel sourcing, group accommodation, room blocks, meeting hotels, resort sourcing.

#### Ground Transportation

#### MICE & Events

#### Staffing & Accreditation
Event personnel, hosts/hostesses, registration, accreditation support, interpreters where required.

### MICE & Corporate Events in Turkey

White-label support can be provided where appropriate, with communication kept agency-oriented and professionally structured.

### DMC Turkey FAQ

#### What does a DMC in Turkey do?
A Turkey DMC handles the full local execution layer for group programmes: hotel sourcing and contracting, ground transportation, venue sourcing, event production and technical services, incentive programme design, meeting and congress management, ground handling, and on-site staffing and coordination. DMC Turkey Partner has operated in Turkey since 2006.

#### Why should an international agency use a local DMC in Turkey?
A local DMC provides established supplier relationships, destination expertise and a single coordination point in Turkey. The agency manages the client relationship; the DMC handles all local contracting, logistics, staffing and on-site execution — reducing supplier fragmentation, local language barriers and time-zone coordination overhead.

#### What is the difference between a DMC and a travel agency?
DMC and travel agency activities can overlap. Our focus is local programme delivery for agencies, corporations and PCOs.

#### Which destinations in Turkey does DMC Turkey Partner cover?
Istanbul, Antalya, Belek, Cappadocia and Bodrum. These five destinations cover the principal MICE, incentive and group travel markets in Turkey and can be combined into multi-city itineraries on a single project. See Destinations .

#### Do you provide MICE services in Turkey?
Yes. Meetings, incentive programmes, conferences and corporate events are the core of the operation. Services cover venue sourcing, delegate logistics, event production, technical production (stage, AV, lighting), F&B and on-site coordination. See MICE Turkey .

#### Can you support incentive travel programs in Turkey?
Yes. Incentive programmes across Turkey's resort and cultural destinations — Antalya, Belek, Cappadocia, Istanbul, Bodrum — are a core service. DMC Turkey Partner handles the full programme: hotel contracting, experiences and excursions, gala dinners, activities, transport and on-site management.

#### Do you offer white-label DMC services in Turkey?
Yes. DMC Turkey Partner can operate as the invisible local layer under your agency's brand. Proposals, supplier communications and on-site documentation use your identity. See White-Label DMC Turkey .

#### Can you manage corporate events and technical production in Turkey?
Yes. Event production services cover staging, sound, lighting, LED screens, live streaming, technical crew, event staffing and décor — coordinated alongside accommodation and logistics in a single operational scope.

#### What group sizes do you work with?
Programmes from approximately 20 to 500+ participants across all service types. Incentive and group travel programmes typically start from around 15 people; conferences and corporate events are commonly 50 to 300 delegates, though larger events have been delivered.

#### How do we request a DMC proposal for Turkey?
Send a brief using the Request a Proposal form, including the destination, group size, dates and the services needed. We respond with options and indicative costings tailored to your brief.

### Planning a Project in Turkey?
Tell us the destination, dates, group size and services required. We can evaluate the operational requirements and prepare the appropriate project scope.

## White-Label DMC Turkey
You keep the client. We execute Turkey. Local destination management, MICE, group travel, event production, accommodation, transportation, supplier coordination and on-the-ground execution for international agencies. Operating since 2006.

### What Is a White-Label DMC Partnership?
The international agency owns and manages the client relationship. DmcTurkeyPartner.com acts as the local operational partner in Turkey, coordinating local services, suppliers and execution on the ground. The overseas agency remains the primary commercial relationship, and white-label support can be provided where appropriate.

### White-Label DMC Turkey FAQ

#### What is a white-label DMC?
A white-label DMC is a destination management company that executes local operations under an agency-led model. DMC Turkey Partner handles all in-country coordination — hotels, transportation, venues, event production, staffing and logistics — while the overseas agency maintains the client-facing relationship and retains full commercial control. The end client sees a seamless programme delivered under the agency's brand.

#### What specifically gets white-labelled?
Ground cost breakdowns are provided in a format the agency incorporates into its own client proposal. Email correspondence, conference calls and supplier updates operate under the agency's communication model. Operational documents — rooming lists, transportation run-sheets, logistics schedules, on-site operations schedules — are formatted to agency requirements. DMC Turkey Partner invoices the agency only, never the end client.

#### Can our agency retain the client relationship?
Yes. Your agency retains its client relationship and brand; we provide local programme delivery. Client communication follows your agreed agency protocol.

#### Can you work with overseas agencies that have no Turkey presence?
Yes. The white-label model is designed specifically for international agencies — travel agencies, MICE agencies, event agencies, incentive houses and tour operators — that require Turkey execution without maintaining a local office. Most partner agencies are based in Europe, the Middle East or North America.

#### What services can DMC Turkey Partner execute locally?
Hotel sourcing and group accommodation (room block contracts and check-in coordination), ground transportation (airport transfers, coaches, private vehicles, shuttle routes), venue sourcing (conference facilities, gala dinner venues, outdoor spaces), event production (AV, staging, lighting, rigging, truss, technical crew), ground handling (arrivals, departures, logistics), staffing (event personnel, hosts/hostesses, interpreters), and MICE coordination (meetings, conferences, corporate events, gala dinners). Operating across Istanbul, Antalya, Belek, Cappadocia and Bodrum since 2006.

#### Which Turkey destinations do you operate in?
Istanbul (year-round; best for meetings, conferences and citybreak incentives), Antalya (April–October; resorts and large-group events), Belek (April–October; resort conferences and golf incentives), Cappadocia (April–November; executive incentives and small groups up to 40 delegates), Bodrum (May–October; premium incentives and private groups up to 80 delegates). See Destinations .

#### Do you work on one-off projects or as an ongoing partner?
Both. Project-based engagements cover a single client programme — the agency sends a brief, DMC Turkey Partner proposes the ground operation, and the partnership closes on delivery. Ongoing partnerships are for agencies with recurring Turkey requirements, where pre-agreed rates and a standing communication structure reduce lead time on each new programme.

#### How do we start working together?
Submit an agency profile via Agency Partners or send a project brief with destination, dates, group size, programme type and required services via Request a Proposal . DMC Turkey Partner responds within one business day with initial availability and a ground-cost indication.

### Need a Local Execution Partner in Turkey?
Send us your agency profile or project brief and tell us the destination, dates, group size and required services.

### Local MICE Planning and Execution Across Turkey

Istanbul is suited to urban meetings, conferences and corporate events. Antalya and Belek support resort-based groups, incentives and conference programmes. Cappadocia and Bodrum offer distinctive settings for smaller incentive and executive programmes.

## Corporate Event Management in Turkey

### Corporate Event Planning and Local Execution in Turkey
DMC Turkey Partner is a Turkey-based destination management company that plans and executes corporate events in Istanbul, Antalya, Belek, Bodrum and Cappadocia. We work with international event agencies, PCOs and corporate travel buyers to handle venue sourcing, hotel contracting, group transportation, event production and full on-site coordination — for corporate groups from 20 to 500 delegates.

### Corporate Event Formats We Coordinate

#### Conferences and meetings
Venue, accommodation, delegate movement and operational planning for business gatherings.

#### Product launches and brand events

#### Team programmes and retreats
Accommodation, transportation and programme logistics for corporate groups.

#### Gala dinners and recognition events
Guest experience, venue, technical and on-site coordination for key programme moments.

### Venue, Production and Guest Logistics
Effective event delivery connects the room, run-of-show and guest journey. Local planning can cover venue evaluation, hotel proximity, arrival and departure movements, speaker or VIP requirements, production coordination, staffing and supplier communication.

### Corporate Events Turkey FAQ

#### What types of corporate events do you organise in Turkey?
DMC Turkey Partner coordinates conferences, product launches, brand events, corporate retreats, team programmes, gala dinners and recognition events across Istanbul, Antalya, Belek, Bodrum and Cappadocia.

#### What group sizes do you work with?
We work with corporate groups from 20 to 500 delegates. Venue and hotel options are matched to the group profile — Istanbul suits larger conferences; Belek and Antalya work best for resort-based corporate programmes.

#### What does a Turkey corporate event DMC actually handle?
A DMC handles the local workstream: venue contracting, hotel room blocks, airport and group transport, event production (AV, staging, lighting), on-site staffing and supplier communication. The agency or corporate team retains client and budget ownership.

#### How much does a corporate event in Turkey cost?
A 60-person corporate event in Antalya typically costs €18,000–€32,000 including venue, 2-night accommodation, catering and transfers. Istanbul rates are higher for venue hire. See our event cost guides for destination-specific breakdowns.

#### Can you coordinate both venue and production?
Yes. Venue sourcing and event production can be planned together with transportation and other local event requirements. All suppliers are managed under a single local coordination point.

#### Can corporate events include accommodation and transfers?
Yes. Hotel sourcing and group transportation are part of the standard local operational scope. We contract hotel room blocks, manage rooming lists and coordinate airport-to-hotel and inter-venue transfers.

#### How do we request a corporate event proposal?
Use the Request a Proposal form and include your dates, group size, event format and required services. We respond with a scoped brief within one business day.

### Turkey Destinations for Group Travel

## Antalya Fam Trips for Agencies & MICE Planners
Last updated: October 2026
A fam trip lets you see the hotels, venues and people behind a destination before you recommend it to a client. DMC Turkey Partner has operated in Turkey since 2006 and can plan and run a fam trip for your agency or client group in Antalya and Belek, with one local team handling the logistics.

### Who a Fam Trip Is For
- Incentive and MICE agencies choosing a destination for upcoming client programmes.
- Corporate event and group travel planners who want to inspect venues first-hand.
- Overseas agencies that need a local partner to host their own buyers or key clients.

### What We Can Arrange

#### Hotel & venue inspections
Site visits to resorts, meeting hotels and event venues in Antalya and Belek, scheduled around your questions.

#### Supplier meetings
Introductions to the teams behind transport, production, staffing and on-site coordination.

#### Transfers & logistics
Airport transfers and ground transport for the whole itinerary.

#### Evening & incentive experiences
Dinners and group activities that show how a programme would feel for your guests.
Need your agency to keep the client relationship? See white-label DMC support .

### Antalya and Belek at a Glance
Antalya offers city hotels, conference venues and a major airport; Belek concentrates large 5-star resorts used for incentive travel and corporate retreats. Read the destination guides for venues, transfers and seasonality: Antalya and Belek . For budgeting, see the published event cost ranges and the event budget calculator .

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is a fam trip?
A familiarisation (fam) trip lets agency and corporate buyers see hotels, venues and suppliers in person before they recommend a destination to clients. A local DMC builds the itinerary and runs the logistics on the ground.

#### Can you organise a fam trip for our own agency or client group?
Yes. Send us the destination, the number of guests and the dates you have in mind. We reply within 24 hours and send an itemised proposal within 3–5 business days. Scope, inclusions and costs are agreed in writing before anything is booked.

#### Which destinations can a fam trip cover?
Antalya and Belek are the focus of this page. We also operate in Istanbul, Cappadocia and Bodrum, so a multi-destination itinerary is possible.

#### Is the 2027 fam trip the same thing?
No. This page describes fam trips we organise for your group. The 2027 Antalya and Belek programme is a separate, invitation-based trip for agencies, described on its own page, and its details remain subject to written confirmation.

#### Can the fam trip run under our agency’s brand?
Where appropriate, yes. We can work white-label: your agency keeps the relationship with its guests and we handle local execution.

## Turkey Destination Management & MICE Services
DmcTurkeyPartner provides destination management, MICE and ground execution services across Turkey for international agencies, tour operators and corporate event planners. From hotel and venue sourcing to transportation, event production, incentive programmes and on-site operations, we coordinate the local delivery behind meetings, events and group travel programmes through one operational partner.
Local execution support for agency and corporate programmes across Turkey.

### DMC Services Across Turkey
A programme rarely needs one service in isolation. We bring together planning, local sourcing, supplier coordination and on-site operations around the requirements of the brief. Whether the priority is a meeting, incentive, corporate event or group itinerary, the operating structure can connect accommodation, venues, transport and delivery teams in one coordinated local operation. This gives agency and planner teams a clear route from initial requirements to execution on the ground.

### Our Destination Management Services

#### Hotel Sourcing in Turkey
Group accommodation, room blocks and meeting requirements are assessed against the programme schedule, destination and guest profile. We coordinate hotel discussions and practical programme fit for agency-led projects.

#### Transportation & Logistics
Airport transfers, group movements, vehicle coordination and routing are planned around arrival patterns, event timings and local operating needs. The focus is a workable transport flow throughout the programme.

#### Venue Sourcing in Turkey
For meetings, dinners, conferences and corporate events, venue options are considered for format, location and operational suitability. Local coordination helps align the selected space with the wider programme plan.

#### Event Production
Production coordination can cover AV, staging, branding, technical suppliers and on-site delivery. We work with the required local production parties to support the event specification and running order.

#### Incentive Programs in Turkey
We support agency-designed incentive programmes with activities, dining, accommodation, transport and local coordination. Each component is planned in context so guest movements and programme moments work together operationally.

#### Group Travel Services
Multi-person itineraries require coordinated accommodation, transportation and local logistics. We help structure the ground operation around group size, dates, routing and the practical requirements of the itinerary.

#### Meetings & Conferences in Turkey
Meeting and conference support combines venues, delegate accommodation, transportation, production coordination and local logistics. The service is shaped around the agenda, delegate flow and operational responsibilities.

#### Ground Handling in Turkey
Airport assistance, supplier coordination, group movements and on-site operational support can be managed as part of the local delivery. This keeps practical ground requirements connected to the live programme.

#### Need a coordinated local service plan?
Share the core requirements and we can help structure the services needed for your programme.

### Turkey DMC Services FAQ

#### What services does a DMC in Turkey provide?
A Turkey DMC provides eight core ground services: hotel sourcing and room-block contracting, ground transportation (airport transfers, coaches, private vehicles), venue sourcing, event production (staging, AV, lighting, crew), incentive programme design and delivery, group travel operations, meetings and conferences management, and ground handling — combined into one local operating structure for each programme.

#### Can you work with international agencies on a white-label basis?
Yes. DMC Turkey Partner can operate as the invisible local layer under your agency's brand. Proposals, supplier communications and on-site documentation use your identity. See White-Label DMC Turkey .

#### Can you manage hotels, venues and transportation under one programme?
Yes. Hotels, ground transportation and venues are coordinated as a single local operation — from airport arrival to departure, including daily transport, hotel coordination, venue setup and event delivery.

#### Which destinations in Turkey do you support?
Istanbul, Antalya, Belek, Cappadocia and Bodrum. Istanbul is the principal MICE and conference hub; Antalya and Belek are the leading resort MICE destinations; Cappadocia is used for incentive and executive groups; Bodrum suits smaller incentive and corporate hospitality programmes. See Destinations .

#### Do you support meetings, incentives and corporate events in Turkey?
Yes. Meetings and conferences cover venue sourcing, delegate logistics and technical production. Incentive programmes cover full design and delivery — hotel, experiences, gala dinners and logistics. Corporate events include staging, AV, branding and on-site crew.

#### Can you coordinate group transportation and ground handling?
Yes. Group transportation covers airport transfers, daily shuttles, coach hire and private vehicle fleet. Ground handling covers airport assistance, VIP meet-and-greet, coordinated multi-flight group arrivals and baggage coordination.

#### What information should we include in a proposal request?
Include the destination, dates, approximate group size, programme type (meeting, incentive, corporate event, group tour), hotel and venue requirements, transport needs and any production or staffing requirements. Budget guidance, even as a range, helps scope correctly.

## Hotel Sourcing in Turkey for MICE & Group Travel
DmcTurkeyPartner supports international agencies and planners with hotel sourcing and group accommodation coordination in Turkey. We assess suitable properties against destination, dates, room requirements, meeting needs, programme format and operational logistics, then coordinate accommodation alongside transportation, venues, events and other local DMC services where required.
Share your destination, dates, room requirements and programme brief.

### Hotel Sourcing for Groups, Meetings & Events in Turkey
Hotel sourcing for a B2B programme is about operational suitability, not simply room price. We help agencies, MICE planners and tour operators evaluate group accommodation around room blocks, meeting requirements, arrival patterns and the wider programme schedule. The accommodation component is considered in relation to destination fit, local movements, event venues and delegate needs, so it can support the practical delivery of a meeting, incentive, corporate event or multi-day group programme.

### What We Consider When Sourcing Your Hotel

#### Destination & Location
Property location is considered in relation to airports, meeting and event venues, planned activities and transport routes. The objective is a location that works with the programme rather than creating avoidable movement issues.

#### Room Requirements
We review guest numbers, room categories, single, twin or double occupancy, arrival and departure patterns, and the room-block requirements needed to accommodate the group structure.

#### Meetings & Event Space
For MICE programmes, the brief can include meeting rooms, breakouts, conference setup, event flow and F&B requirements. These needs help determine whether accommodation and programme activity can work together.

#### Group Logistics
Coach access, arrival flow, airport transfers, group movements and programme timings all affect accommodation suitability. These details are considered alongside the hotel requirement from the beginning.

#### Programme Profile
The right hotel approach depends on whether the programme is a conference, incentive, corporate event, group tour or executive meeting. Each format creates a different balance of accommodation and operational needs.

### Contract Rates vs Spot Rates
Hotel pricing for groups can follow two structures. Contract rates are pre-negotiated block rates secured in advance against a confirmed room allotment, typically offering better per-room pricing in exchange for a minimum commitment and cancellation policy. Spot rates are quoted at time of enquiry against live availability, with no prior commitment, and are subject to the market at the time of request. For MICE programmes with a defined headcount and firm dates, a contracted room block usually provides cost certainty and operational reliability. For programmes with uncertain numbers or flexible dates, a spot-rate approach may be more appropriate. DMC Turkey Partner can advise on the right approach for each programme brief.

### More Than Hotel Booking
Hotel sourcing is part of destination management, not an OTA-style room booking service. For groups and MICE programmes, the most suitable hotel is not always simply the lowest room rate. Location, movement times, meeting requirements, coach access and the wider programme schedule can be equally important. We can connect accommodation planning to transportation and logistics , venue sourcing , event production and ground handling , allowing the local delivery to be assessed as one operating plan.

### Agency & White-Label Hotel Sourcing Support
International agencies can use DmcTurkeyPartner as the local accommodation and operations layer behind a Turkey programme. Your agency can retain the client relationship while hotel sourcing, group requirements and local coordination are handled as part of the wider DMC brief. This can work for a defined project or as part of an ongoing agency operating relationship. Learn more about White-Label DMC Support for Agencies .

- Destination and arrival/departure dates

Centralised coordination helps keep hotel requirements aligned with transfers, venues and on-site delivery rather than handled as a separate booking task. It also gives agency and planner teams one operational route for the accommodation component and related ground requirements during planning and execution.

### Hotel Sourcing Turkey FAQ

#### Can you source hotels for large groups in Turkey?
Yes. DMC Turkey Partner assesses group accommodation requirements including room count, room configuration, dates, destination and programme logistics, then structures suitable options for the project brief. Antalya and Belek resort hotels can accommodate groups from 50 to over 2,500 delegates. Istanbul city hotels range from small executive meetings to full congress events.

#### What is the difference between contract rates and spot rates for hotel groups?
Contract rates are pre-negotiated block rates secured in advance against a confirmed room allotment, typically offering better per-room pricing in exchange for a minimum commitment and cancellation policy. Spot rates are quoted at time of enquiry against live availability, with no prior commitment, and are subject to the market at that moment. For MICE programmes with a defined headcount and firm dates, a contracted room block usually provides cost certainty and operational reliability.

#### Can you source hotels with meeting and conference facilities?
Yes. Meeting rooms, breakout needs, conference setup and F&B requirements can be included in the accommodation brief. Belek and Antalya resort hotels typically include dedicated conference centres with plenary capacity from 500 to 2,500+ delegates. Istanbul 5-star hotels offer ballroom capacities from 200 to 1,000+ pax.

#### Which destinations in Turkey can you support?
DMC Turkey Partner covers Istanbul (year-round, city business hotels and 5-star venues), Antalya (April–October, large resort hotels with full MICE infrastructure), Belek (April–October, 7–10 all-inclusive resort hotels purpose-built for groups), Bodrum (May–October, luxury boutique and resort hotels for small groups up to 80 pax), and Cappadocia (April–November, cave hotels for executive incentives up to 40 pax).

#### Can hotel sourcing be combined with airport transfers and transportation?
Yes. Accommodation planning is coordinated with transportation and logistics , including airport transfers, routing and group movements. Hotel location affects transfer times: Antalya AYT airport to city hotels is 15–30 minutes; to Belek resort hotels is 30–45 minutes. Istanbul has two airports — IST (35–60 minutes to city centre) and SAW (40–70 minutes).

#### Do you support incentive and corporate event groups?
Yes. Hotel sourcing can be integrated with activities, dining, venues, production and local logistics for incentive programmes and corporate events. Belek all-inclusive resorts are particularly suited to corporate incentives requiring accommodation, F&B, activities and event production in one location.

#### What information do you need before sourcing hotel options?
Destination, dates, group and room numbers, room configuration (single/twin/double), hotel category preference (4-star/5-star/resort), meeting room needs, F&B requirements, approximate budget per room per night, and arrival/departure flight details provide the strongest starting brief.

### Need Hotel Options for a Turkey Programme?
Share your destination, dates, group size, room requirements and programme brief. We can review accommodation needs alongside the wider local logistics required for your project.

## Group Transportation Turkey | MICE & Event Logistics
URL: https://dmcturkeypartner.com/services/transportation-logistics/


## Group Transportation & Event Logistics in Turkey
DmcTurkeyPartner coordinates ground transportation and group logistics in Turkey for agencies and MICE planners. From airport arrivals and hotel transfers to conference shuttles, venue movements and multi-day programme logistics, transportation is planned around the itinerary, group profile and schedule, with coordination across the programme.

### Group Transportation & Logistics for Turkey Programmes
Transportation for meetings, events and groups is a programme-level operation rather than a single vehicle booking. We coordinate airport arrivals, hotel and venue transfers, event shuttles, group movements and multi-day transport around the itinerary. Route planning, vehicle requirements and timing are shaped by flight schedules, group profile, programme sequence and local operating needs, helping the transportation component work with the wider DMC plan.

### Transportation Services We Coordinate

#### Airport Arrivals & Departures
Arrival and departure schedules, airport-to-hotel movements, group coordination and vehicle timing are planned around flight patterns and the onward programme. For airport assistance and guest handling, see Ground Handling .

#### Group Transfers
We coordinate organised group movements between hotels, venues, restaurants, activities and events. Each transfer is planned in relation to the programme schedule and the movement requirements of the group.

#### Meetings & Conference Transportation
Delegate movements, conference shuttles, hotel-to-venue routing and peak arrival periods are aligned with the meeting schedule, helping transport support the practical flow of the event day.

#### Event Transportation
Corporate events, dinners, off-site venues, productions and evening programmes can require closely timed guest movements. Transport is coordinated around venue access, event timings and the live programme.

#### Incentive Programme Logistics
Multi-stop incentive itineraries can combine hotels, restaurants, activities and off-site experiences. Daily movement schedules are planned to connect each part of the programme operationally.

#### Multi-Day Group Transportation
For group travel programmes, scheduled movements, destination transfers and multi-day routing are coordinated around the itinerary, with vehicle continuity considered where operationally appropriate.

### Vehicle Types & Typical Group Capacities
Vehicle selection depends on group size, luggage volume, route requirements and whether the movement is an airport transfer or a programme shuttle. The table below shows the typical vehicle categories used for MICE and group programmes in Turkey.
Vehicle type Typical passenger capacity Best suited for
Sedan / executive car 1–3 passengers VIP transfers, individual executive arrivals, small private movements
MPV / people carrier 4–7 passengers Small group transfers, executive team movements, private vehicle requests
Minibus (small) 8–14 passengers Sub-group transfers, breakout activity movements, accommodation shuttles
Minibus (standard) 15–24 passengers Medium group transfers, conference delegate movements, venue shuttles
Midibus 25–35 passengers Group dinner transfers, off-site activities, hotel-to-venue movements
Full-size coach 40–55 passengers Large group airport transfers, conference delegate shuttles, multi-hotel routes
Double-decker coach 70–90 passengers Very large group movements (available at select major destinations)
Note: actual passenger capacity depends on luggage, accessibility requirements and vehicle specification. Planned capacity is typically set 10–15% below nominal maximum for luggage and comfort.

### Antalya Transfer Pricing
For Antalya we publish indicative per-vehicle rates. Airport transfers from €70, daily shuttles from €260 and a full-day vehicle with driver from €380 — per vehicle, not per person. These rates apply to Antalya only; transport in other destinations is quoted per programme.

### Transportation Planning Beyond Vehicle Booking
For MICE and group programmes, transportation is an operational system rather than a single transfer. Passenger count, luggage volume, arrival and departure waves, hotel and venue locations, event timings, route requirements, loading considerations and programme sequence all affect the transport plan. We coordinate the movement structure around these variables and the communication needed between local suppliers and operational teams.

### Integrated with Your Full DMC Programme
Transportation does not operate independently from the rest of a programme. Hotel sourcing affects the route structure; venue sourcing shapes movements and access; event timings affect vehicle schedules; and flight patterns inform arrival operations. We can coordinate transport alongside event production , meetings and conferences and ground handling .

### Ground Transportation for International Agency Partners
International agencies can use DmcTurkeyPartner as the local Turkey execution layer for transportation and programme logistics while retaining ownership of their client relationship. Transport can be coordinated as a defined operational component or integrated into a wider destination management brief covering accommodation, venues, events and local delivery. Explore White-Label DMC Support in Turkey for agency-led projects and ongoing operating relationships.

### Why Coordinate Transportation Through a Local DMC?
A local DMC provides a single coordination point for programme-level transport planning, supplier communication and schedule alignment. Transport can be evaluated against destination context, hotels, venues and live event requirements rather than planned separately. This reduces operational fragmentation for agency and planner teams, while local coordination supports the practical delivery of group movements throughout the programme.

### Group Transportation Turkey FAQ

#### Can you coordinate airport transfers for large groups in Turkey?
Yes. Arrival and departure movements can be planned around flight schedules, group size, luggage requirements, hotel locations and the onward programme. For large groups arriving on multiple flights, a staged vehicle plan with coaches (40–55 pax capacity) ensures groups clear the airport without extended waits.

#### How long are airport transfers in Turkey's main MICE destinations?
Approximate transfer times under normal traffic: Istanbul IST to city centre 35–60 minutes; Istanbul SAW to Asian side 40–70 minutes; Antalya AYT to city hotels 15–30 minutes; Antalya AYT to Belek resort area 30–45 minutes; Bodrum BJV to Bodrum town 35–50 minutes; Cappadocia NAV to Goreme 35–50 minutes. Allow additional time when multiple flights land within a short window.

#### What vehicle types do you use for group programmes?
Vehicles are selected by group size: sedan/executive car (1–3 pax), MPV (4–7 pax), small minibus (8–14 pax), standard minibus (15–24 pax), midibus (25–35 pax), full-size coach (40–55 pax). Planned capacity is typically set 10–15% below nominal maximum for luggage and comfort.

#### Do you coordinate transportation for conferences and corporate events?
Yes. Delegate movements, hotel-to-venue transfers, event shuttles and timing requirements can be coordinated as part of the event operation. Conference shuttle routes between multiple hotels and a conference venue are planned around the daily agenda, not as a flat timetable.

#### Can you manage transportation for multi-day incentive programmes?
Yes. Multi-day routing, activity movements, restaurants, hotels and off-site programme elements can be connected in the transport plan. Each day's movement schedule is built around the programme itinerary.

#### Can transportation be combined with hotel and venue sourcing?
Yes. Hotel and venue decisions directly affect routing and vehicle schedules, so they can be coordinated together within the wider DMC programme. For example, a Belek resort hotel is evaluated alongside the conference centre's coach loading access and airport transfer route from Antalya AYT (30–45 minutes).

#### What information do you need to prepare a transportation plan?
Destination, dates, group size, arrival and departure flights (times and flight numbers where available), hotel and venue addresses, daily programme schedule, luggage requirements, any VIP or accessibility requirements, and the point of contact for on-site coordination.

### Planning Group Transportation in Turkey?
Share your destination, dates, group size, flights, hotels, venues and programme schedule. We can review the movement requirements and structure the transportation component alongside the wider DMC operation.

## Antalya Airport and Group Transfer Prices
Indicative prices per vehicle for the three ways groups move around Antalya: airport transfers, daily conference and hotel shuttles, and a vehicle with driver dedicated to your programme for the day. Sedans to 50-seat coaches, operated by our Antalya team.
Prices reviewed: 9 October 2026 .

### Transfer Prices by Vehicle
Vehicle and capacity Airport transfer, one way Daily shuttle, out and back Full-day vehicle with driver
Sedan, up to 3 passengers €70 On request On request
Van, up to 6 passengers €90 On request On request
Minibus, up to 19 passengers €160 €260 €380
Midibus, up to 27 passengers €240 €330 €480
Coach, up to 50 passengers* €320 €450 €650
*Final capacity is confirmed against luggage and any seat needed for a coordinator.

### What Each Price Includes
Service Included in the price
Airport transfer One way, one drop-off point, up to 35 km; meet & greet and up to 60 minutes' waiting after landing.
Daily shuttle One outbound and one return run; 100 km and 4 active working hours in total. The vehicle does not wait between runs.
Full-day vehicle with driver 10 consecutive working hours and 150 km; the vehicle is dedicated to your programme for the whole day.
The daily shuttle and the full-day vehicle are alternatives for the same day; they are not charged together.

### Extra Hours and Kilometres
Vehicle Extra waiting / working hour Extra kilometre
Sedan / van €20 €1
Minibus €25 €1
Midibus €30 €1.20
Coach €40 €1.50
Sedan and van hourly rates apply to extra airport waiting time. For other vehicles, the hourly rate applies once the time included in the service is exceeded.
Indicative prices per vehicle in EUR, excluding applicable taxes. Final pricing depends on confirmed routes, dates, luggage requirements and vehicle availability.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### Are these prices per person or per vehicle?
Per vehicle. The price is the same whether a minibus carries 8 or 19 passengers, so the right vehicle size matters more than the headcount.

#### How much luggage fits?
Capacities assume normal suitcases. Oversized items, equipment cases or a seat for a group coordinator can mean a larger vehicle — tell us the luggage when you ask for a quote.

#### Our group arrives on different flights. How is that priced?
Each vehicle movement is priced separately. Where flights land close together we can combine passengers into one vehicle; where they do not, waiting beyond the included 60 minutes is charged per hour, or a second vehicle is usually cheaper.

#### Is a return airport transfer double the one-way price?
Yes — the airport price is one way, so arrival and departure are two transfers. Book both together so the return is reserved.

#### What is the difference between the daily shuttle and a full-day vehicle?
The daily shuttle is one run out and one run back, with the vehicle released in between. A full-day vehicle stays with your group for 10 hours and can make as many movements as the programme needs. They are alternatives, not combined.

### Request a Transfer Quote
Send the dates, passengers, luggage and route. We confirm vehicles and a firm price.

### Thank you — we’ve received your request.
Our Antalya operations team will confirm vehicles and pricing by email.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What are off-peak dates for events in Turkey?
Off-peak dates are the weeks when demand from conferences and incentive groups is lowest, so hotels have conference capacity to spare. The window differs by destination: for example December – February in Belek and Antalya, October – April in Bodrum.

#### Can an off-season event cost less than one in peak season?
Off-peak dates can lower hotel, resort and venue rates and improve availability. We quantify the difference in your proposal, line by line, for your own dates and group.

#### Are hotels and venues open in the off-season?
Not all of them. Resorts and hotels close or reduce facilities at different times, so we confirm which properties, conference rooms and services are open for your exact dates before we quote.

#### Can we compare dates before committing?
Yes. Choose “Compare off-peak and peak-season dates side by side” in the brief and we price the same programme in both windows. A proposal is not a booking.

## Off-Season Events in Belek: Off-Peak Resort Dates & Planning Windows
Current season: Winter 2026/27 · Last updated: October 2026
Belek is Turkey’s resort-based meetings district: conference wings inside all-inclusive resorts, 30–45 minutes from Antalya Airport. From December to February the resorts are at their quietest, which is when agencies with flexible dates can plan dealer meetings, retreats and golf incentives with better availability and lower rates than in the spring and autumn peaks.
- Reply within 24 hours
- Side-by-side proposal in 3–5 business days
- Named coordinator once you confirm

### Suitable Date Windows
Window Role What to expect
December – February Core off-peak window Best availability and the most room to negotiate. Which resorts and conference wings are open is confirmed per brief.
New Year week and public holidays Exceptions Demand and rates can differ sharply; these weeks are usually priced separately.
March – June and September – November Peak MICE months The comparison baseline: the busiest conference and incentive months.
July – August Summer leisure peak Family and leisure demand; published rates carry a 15–25% premium.

### Events That Fit the Off-Peak Window

#### Dealer & sales meetings
Regional dealer conferences and sales kick-offs that need a ballroom, breakouts and a gala dinner under one roof.

#### Training & conferences
Multi-day programmes of 100–300 delegates with team-building.

#### Board & leadership retreats
Smaller executive groups that value quiet resorts and flexible meeting rooms.

#### Golf incentives
Groups of 30–80, subject to course conditions; an indoor alternative is planned alongside.
Typical off-peak groups are 30–300 guests. Larger groups depend on which conference wings are open for your dates.

#### Are Belek resorts open for meetings in winter?
Some are, with their conference wings, but not every resort keeps every facility open from December to February. We confirm which resorts and rooms are available for your dates before quoting.

#### Can a golf incentive run in winter?
Course availability and playing conditions vary in winter, so golf is confirmed per course and date and an indoor alternative is planned alongside it.

#### How do you calculate the difference between off-peak and peak dates?
We price the same programme twice, in the off-peak window and in a peak-season window: same hotel category, scope, group size and nights. The difference is shown line by line in your proposal.

## Off-Season Events in Istanbul | Off-Peak Dates & Costs
URL: https://dmcturkeypartner.com/off-season-events-turkey/istanbul/


## Off-Season Events in Istanbul: Off-Peak Dates & Planning Windows
Current season: Winter 2026/27 · Last updated: October 2026
Istanbul is Turkey’s city destination for conferences, executive meetings and corporate events, with the largest concentration of meeting-capable city hotels. In January and February demand from conference groups is lower, which gives planners with flexible dates more availability and more room to negotiate. Because Istanbul is priced line by line, we show the date comparison the same way.
- Reply within 24 hours
- Side-by-side proposal in 3–5 business days
- Named coordinator once you confirm
Scope of this page: city programmes in Istanbul: business hotels, city venues and short-stay groups. For resort-based programmes see Belek ; for city and coast in the south see Antalya . For an all-year overview see the Istanbul destination guide .

### Suitable Date Windows
Window Role What to expect
January – February Core off-peak window Cooler weather (about 5–12°C) and the most room to negotiate. Meeting rooms and venues are confirmed per brief.
July – August Possible secondary window Quieter for business events, but peak leisure season for city hotels; published rates carry a 15–25% premium. We compare it before assuming a saving.
New Year week and public holidays Exceptions Demand and rates can differ sharply; these weeks are usually priced separately.
March – June and September – November Peak MICE months The comparison baseline: the busiest conference and incentive months.

### Events That Fit the Off-Peak Window

#### Conferences & congresses
Business sessions that need meeting rooms, AV and a hosted dinner in a city hotel or congress venue.

#### Executive & board meetings
Short stays of 20–60 guests where hotel location and meeting-room quality matter most.

#### Corporate events & hosted dinners
Company events combining a business day with a hosted dinner or an optional city experience.

#### Premium city incentives
Small groups of 30–80 with indoor-first cultural programmes and a Bosphorus experience where conditions allow.

### Cost Comparison
Published reference ranges for Istanbul, shown for the spring and autumn programme season (April – June and September – November). They are the starting point for the comparison, not an off-peak price.
Programme type Group size (pax) Nights Budget range (€/pax)
3-night conference (4-star city hotel) 50–150 3 €350–500
3-night conference (5-star Bosphorus hotel) 50–150 3 €500–650
3-night corporate event + hosted dinner (5-star) 50–150 3 €550–750
4-night incentive with Bosphorus cruise (5-star) 30–80 4 €700–1,000
2-night executive meeting (5-star) 20–60 2 €400–600
All-in per-person totals: hotel accommodation, venue hire or ballroom use, full-board F&B (or equivalent), airport transfers, programme activities and DMC management fee. Flights excluded. Istanbul is priced as itemised line items: room, meeting space, F&B and production. Peak July – August carries a 15–25% premium. Source: Istanbul event costs .

Compare Dates & Event Costs

### Operating Conditions

#### Hotel and venue availability
City hotels generally operate all year, but meeting rooms, venues and city events calendars differ by date. We confirm availability for your dates before we quote.

#### Getting around
Istanbul Airport is 35–45 km from the city centre (40–60 minutes by road). Traffic affects transfer timing, so group movements are kept to a minimum.

#### Weather and indoor plan
Winter days are cool (about 5–12°C), so programmes are planned indoor-first: hotel meeting rooms, museums, covered venues and dinners, with outdoor sessions as weather-dependent additions.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### When is the off-peak window for events in Istanbul?
January – February is the core off-peak window for corporate and conference groups. July – August can also be quieter for business events, but it is peak leisure season for city hotels, so we compare it before assuming a saving. April – June and September – November are the busiest MICE months.

#### Is Istanbul priced differently from Antalya or Belek?
Yes. Istanbul hotels are typically room-only or bed-and-breakfast, and meeting space, food and beverage and production are itemised, so the comparison between dates is shown line by line rather than as one all-inclusive rate.

#### Are hotels and venues open and available in winter?
City hotels generally operate all year, but meeting rooms, venues and events calendars differ by date. We confirm availability for your exact dates before we quote.

#### How do you calculate the difference between off-peak and peak dates?
We price the same programme twice, in the off-peak window and in a peak-season window: same hotel category, scope, group size and nights. The difference is shown line by line in your proposal.

## Off-Season Events in Bodrum | Off-Peak Dates & Costs
URL: https://dmcturkeypartner.com/off-season-events-turkey/bodrum/


## Off-Season Events in Bodrum: Off-Peak Dates & Planning Windows
Current season: Winter 2026/27 · Last updated: October 2026
Bodrum is a small-group destination: boutique hotels, private villas and Aegean experiences for incentives and executive retreats of roughly 15–80 guests. The planning window runs from October to April. It is a different kind of off-season from Antalya’s: October and April are the strongest months for small groups, while from November to March many boutique hotels and gulet operators close, so availability is confirmed before anything is quoted.
- Reply within 24 hours
- Side-by-side proposal in 3–5 business days
- Named coordinator once you confirm
Scope of this page: small-group and premium programmes in Bodrum. For resort conferences see Belek or Antalya ; for an all-year overview see the Bodrum destination guide .

### Suitable Date Windows
Window Role What to expect
October Strong off-peak month Mild weather, hotels still fully operational and little leisure traffic; one of the best months for small groups.
April Strong off-peak month Quiet and mild; boutique hotels are reopening, which suits small executive retreats.
November – March Limited availability Cooler (about 10–18°C). Many boutique hotels and gulet operators are closed; city-centre properties stay open. Confirmed per brief.
May – June, September and July – August Comparison baseline May – June and September are the main shoulder months; July – August is peak leisure season with the highest rates.

### Events That Fit the Off-Peak Window

#### Executive retreats
Small leadership groups in a boutique hotel or private villa with a private programme.

#### Premium incentives
Reward trips of 15–80 guests built around a boutique hotel, local gastronomy and cultural experiences.

#### Private group programmes
Corporate hospitality and private gatherings for groups that value privacy over scale.

#### Hotel-based winter meetings
Short meetings in properties that stay open year-round, planned indoor-first.
Typical Bodrum groups are 15–80 guests, up to about 120 across several properties.

### Cost Comparison
Published reference figures for Bodrum, based on the shoulder season (May – June and October). They are the starting point for the comparison, not an off-peak price.
Programme type Group size (pax) Nights Budget range (€/pax)

Compare Dates & Event Costs

### Operating Conditions

#### Hotel and service availability
Many boutique hotels and gulet operators close from November to March; city-centre properties stay open. We confirm what is operating for your dates before we quote.

#### Getting there
Milas-Bodrum Airport (BJV) is 30–45 minutes from Bodrum town and Yalıkavak marina.

#### Weather and indoor plan
Gulet and yacht programmes depend on operators and sea conditions and are best from May to October, so outside those months we plan hotel-based, indoor-first programmes.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### When is the off-peak window for events in Bodrum?
October – April is the planning window. October and April are the strongest months for small groups, because most boutique hotels are open and the weather is mild. From November to March many boutique hotels and gulet operators are closed, so the options are narrower.

#### Are Bodrum hotels and gulets open in winter?
Many boutique hotels and gulet operators close from November to March, while city-centre properties stay open. We confirm exactly which properties and services are operating for your dates before we quote.

#### Can we still plan a gulet or yacht programme outside summer?
Gulet and yacht programmes depend on operator availability and sea conditions, and they are best from May to October. Outside those months we plan hotel-based and indoor programmes instead.

#### How do you calculate the difference between off-peak and peak dates?
We price the same programme twice, in the off-peak window and in a peak-season window: same hotel category, scope, group size and nights. The difference is shown line by line in your proposal.

## Off-Season Events in Cappadocia | Off-Peak Dates & Costs
URL: https://dmcturkeypartner.com/off-season-events-turkey/cappadocia/


## Off-Season Events in Cappadocia: Off-Peak Dates & Planning Windows
Current season: Winter 2026/27 · Last updated: October 2026
Cappadocia suits small and mid-sized groups that want an experience rather than a conference: cave hotels, valley walks and private dinners. The planning window is December to February, excluding New Year week. It is the quietest and coldest part of the year, and hot air balloon flights are far less reliable, so this window works best for groups that are comfortable without a guaranteed balloon.
- Reply within 24 hours
- Side-by-side proposal in 3–5 business days
- Named coordinator once you confirm
Scope of this page: incentives and executive groups in Cappadocia. There is no convention centre, so large conferences are better placed in Istanbul or Antalya . For an all-year overview see the Cappadocia destination guide .

### Suitable Date Windows
Window Role What to expect
December – February Core off-peak window Cold, with snow possible. Quietest period and the most room to negotiate; balloon cancellations are frequent (30–40% between October and April). Confirmed per brief.
New Year week Excluded Demand and rates differ sharply, so it is priced separately.
April – June and September – October Comparison baseline The best incentive season: mild weather and a lower balloon cancellation rate.
July – August Hot and crowded Hot and busy; not the preferred months for groups.

### Events That Fit the Off-Peak Window

#### Quiet incentives
Small reward groups of 15–100 in cave hotels, with valley walks, private dinners and cultural experiences instead of a balloon-led day.

#### Executive groups
Leadership groups that want a distinctive setting and small boardroom sessions of 10–30 in a cave-hotel meeting room.

#### Experience-led retreats
Two- to four-day programmes with free exploration time, planned indoor-first for winter weather.
Ideal groups are 15–100 guests; up to 150 across several properties. Cave hotels are boutique scale, around 20–40 rooms each.

### Cost Comparison
Published reference figures for Cappadocia, based on the best incentive season (April – June and September – October). They are the starting point for the comparison, not an off-peak price.
Programme type Group size (pax) Nights Budget range (€/pax)
Cave hotel incentive (April – June, September – October) 15–100 (ideal) 3 €800–1,200
Cave hotel, balloon, private valley dinner 15–100 (ideal) 3 €800–1,400
Planning ranges per person; flights excluded. Sources: the Turkey event costs overview and the Cappadocia destination guide . Cappadocia has no separate event-cost page yet.

#### How the comparison works
For your dates we price the off-peak window and a peak-season window side by side for the same programme: same hotel category, scope, group size and nights. Off-peak dates can lower hotel, resort and venue rates and improve availability. We quantify the difference in your proposal, line by line, for your own dates and group.
Compare Dates & Event Costs

### Operating Conditions

#### Balloon reliability
Flights are weather-dependent. Cancellations are far more frequent from November to March, so we plan a backup morning and a non-balloon highlight.

#### Hotel availability
Cave hotels differ in which rooms and services they keep open in winter. We confirm availability for your dates before we quote.

#### Getting there and around
Nevşehir Kapadokya Airport (NAV) is 45–60 minutes from Göreme and Ürgüp; Kayseri Airport (ASR) is 75–90 minutes. Minibuses suit the narrow valley roads, and cold or snowy conditions can affect transfers.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### When is the off-peak window for events in Cappadocia?
December – February, excluding New Year week, is the planning window. It is cold and can be snowy, so it suits small groups that want a quiet cave-hotel stay rather than a balloon-led programme.

#### Can we still plan a balloon flight in winter?
Balloon flights are weather-dependent and cancellations are much more frequent from November to March, so a balloon is never guaranteed. We plan a backup morning and an alternative experience.

#### Are cave hotels open and available in winter?
Properties differ in which rooms and services they keep open from December to February. We confirm availability for your exact dates before we quote.

#### How do you calculate the difference between off-peak and peak dates?
We price the same programme twice, in the off-peak window and in a peak-season window: same hotel category, scope, group size and nights. The difference is shown line by line in your proposal.

## DMC Turecko: incentivní cesty, MICE a firemní akce na místě
Naposledy aktualizováno: 12. 10. 2026
DMC Turkey Partner je destinační management společnost se sídlem v Antalyi, která v Turecku působí od roku 2006. Pro mezinárodní agentury, incentivní společnosti a firmy zajišťujeme MICE programy, incentivní cesty, firemní akce a skupinové cesty v Istanbulu, Antalyi, Beleku, Kappadokii a Bodrumu: od zajištění hotelů a míst konání přes transfery a produkci akcí až po podporu na místě.

### Co v Turecku zajišťuje DMC

#### Hotely
Skupinové ubytování, kontingenty pokojů, kongresové hotely a resorty.

Transfery z letiště, soukromá vozidla, autobusy, skupinové kyvadlové linky a VIP transfery.

Kongresová místa, prostory pro akce, místa pro večeře a neobvyklé lokace.

Schůzky, incentivní cesty, konference, firemní akce a galavečeře.

Zvuk, světla, video, pódium, konstrukce a technická koordinace.

Hostesky, registrace a na přání tlumočníci.

#### Istanbul
Schůzky, konference, firemní akce, incentivní cesty a prémiové skupiny.

Velké skupiny, konference, incentivní cesty, resorty a firemní hospitalita.

Prémiové incentivní cesty, firemní hospitalita a soukromé skupiny.

### Orientační hodnoty rozpočtu
Zveřejněné orientační hodnoty na osobu, bez letenek, pro mezisezónu (duben–červen, září–listopad):
- Incentivní cesta, 4 noci, 5* all-inclusive resort v Antalyi (50–150 hostů): 500–750 € — Antalya (anglicky)
- Firemní retreat, 4 noci, 5* all-inclusive resort v Beleku (50–150 hostů): 500–750 € — Belek (anglicky)
- Konference, 3 noci, 4* městský hotel v Istanbulu (50–150 hostů): 350–500 € — Istanbul (anglicky)
Nezávazné plánovací hodnoty. Ve vrcholné sezóně (červenec–srpen) se uplatňuje příplatek 15–25 %. Vlastní scénáře si můžete projít v kalkulačce rozpočtu (anglicky).

## Venue Sourcing for Meetings & Corporate Events in Turkey
DmcTurkeyPartner supports agencies with venue sourcing across Turkey for meetings, conferences, corporate events, incentive programmes and private group functions. Options are assessed against the event brief, guest profile, capacity, location, production requirements, transportation and programme logistics, helping planners evaluate a venue within the operational context.
Share your destination, dates, guest count, format and venue requirements.

### Venue Sourcing for Meetings, MICE Events & Group Programmes in Turkey
We source venues for meetings, conferences, corporate events, gala dinners, off-site programmes and incentive groups. Selection is not based on appearance alone. Location, event format, capacity, guest flow, transportation, production, F&B and programme timing can all affect whether a venue is operationally suitable. The goal is to identify spaces that work with the brief and the wider programme plan.

### What We Consider When Sourcing a Venue

#### Event Format & Capacity
Conference, meeting, dinner, reception, launch, corporate event and incentive function requirements each create a different venue brief. Capacity is assessed for the intended format, not simply a headline maximum.

#### Location & Accessibility
Hotel locations, guest transportation, programme schedule, surrounding activities and venue access are considered so the selected space works with the wider local operation.

#### Layout & Guest Flow
Registration, arrivals, seating, breakout areas, stage sightlines, F&B flow, entry and exit routes, and back-of-house requirements inform how a venue can support the event.

#### Production Requirements
AV, staging, branding, lighting, power, technical access and load-in considerations can affect suitability. We coordinate these details with Event Production .

#### Food & Beverage
Venue F&B capability and the requirements of the programme influence the assessment, including meal formats, timing and how guest flow is managed around service.

#### Transportation & Logistics
Hotel-to-venue movements, coach access, arrival timing, guest flow and supplier access are reviewed with Transportation & Logistics .

### Venues We Can Source by Programme Type

#### Meetings & Conferences
Conference hotels, meeting venues, conference centres and dedicated meeting spaces can be assessed around delegate, breakout and agenda requirements.

#### Corporate Events
Receptions, corporate dinners, launch events, networking events and company gatherings each require a venue approach shaped by guest and programme flow.

#### Incentive Programmes
Off-site dinners, private group venues, experience-led locations and evening functions can be evaluated in relation to the incentive itinerary.

#### Gala Dinners & Private Functions
Seating, F&B, transport, production and guest flow all inform venue planning for a dinner or private group function.

### Venue Sourcing Integrated with Event Production
Venue selection and production planning should not happen independently. AV, staging, lighting, branding, power, technical access, load-in, guest flow and programme timing may influence whether a space is operationally suitable long before the event date. We coordinate venue evaluation with local event production planning so the selected location can be reviewed in the context of the actual event requirements.

### Venue Sourcing Integrated with Transportation & Hotels
A visually strong venue may still be operationally weak if it creates difficult group movements, long programme gaps or hotel logistics problems. Hotel sourcing , venue location and group transport planning are therefore assessed together. This helps align guest movements, programme sequencing and event timing with the selected space and wider delivery plan.

A local DMC provides venue evaluation in programme context, bringing together destination knowledge, supplier coordination, transport integration and production considerations. Rather than treating the venue as a stand-alone search, the brief can be assessed against hotel locations, guest movements, event flow and on-site requirements. This gives agencies and planners a single local operational contact for venue planning and related programme coordination.

### Venue Sourcing Turkey FAQ

#### What types of venues can you source in Turkey?
DMC Turkey Partner sources conference and congress venues (Istanbul ICC: 5,000+ delegates; Antalya EXPO Center: 2,500+; Belek resort conference centres: up to 2,000), hotel ballrooms (200–2,000 pax depending on destination), gala and dinner venues (waterfront, rooftop and historical sites in Istanbul; resort terraces in Antalya/Belek), outdoor and unique venues (Bosphorus cruises, cave venues in Cappadocia, yacht charters in Bodrum), and private dining spaces.

#### Can you source venues for meetings and conferences in Turkey?
Yes. Meeting space, breakouts, conference setup, F&B and delegate flow can be included in the brief. Istanbul's ICC hosts congresses over 5,000 delegates; Antalya EXPO Center handles events to 2,500+; Belek resort conference centres support 500–2,000 delegates in integrated meeting and accommodation environments. See Meetings & Conferences .

#### Can you source venues for corporate events and gala dinners?
Yes. Corporate dinners, receptions, launches, networking and gala formats can be evaluated with seating, guest flow, production and transport requirements. Istanbul offers rooftop venues, Bosphorus waterfront spaces and historical palace hire. Antalya and Belek offer resort terraces and outdoor beach settings for groups up to 1,000 pax.

#### Can venue sourcing include production requirements?
Yes. AV, staging, lighting, power and technical access can form part of the venue evaluation alongside event production planning. Rigging points, power capacity, loading access and blackout capability are assessed at shortlisting stage for technically demanding events. See Event Production .

#### Can transportation be coordinated with the venue?
Yes. Venue access, coach loading areas and programme timing can be planned together with transportation and logistics . Venue location affects transfer times: Antalya EXPO Center is 20–35 minutes from AYT; Istanbul ICC is 45–75 minutes from IST.

#### Which destinations in Turkey can you support?
Istanbul (congress centres, hotel ballrooms, unique urban venues — year-round), Antalya (resort venues, EXPO Center — April–October), Belek (resort conference centres — April–October), Bodrum (boutique and waterfront venues up to 300 pax — May–October), Cappadocia (cave venues up to 150 pax — April–November).

#### What information should we include in a venue brief?
Destination, date, guest count, event format (conference/dinner/reception/launch), required area, layout preference (theatre/cabaret/banquet/boardroom), F&B requirements, production needs (AV, staging, lighting), transport and budget guidance. For congress venues, add the number of parallel sessions and breakout rooms required.

### Why Use a Local Event Production Partner in Turkey?
A local production partner provides a single operational interface for supplier coordination, venue integration, production logistics and on-site delivery. Local knowledge helps align the event plan with programme timing, guest movement and practical supplier requirements. This reduces fragmentation for agencies coordinating an event remotely.

### Event Production Turkey FAQ

#### What event production services can you coordinate in Turkey?
DMC Turkey Partner coordinates AV (PA systems, display screens, LED walls), staging and platform structures, rigging and truss, intelligent lighting, simultaneous interpretation equipment, branded print and signage, and event staff and hostesses. Standard conference AV and staging are widely available locally in Istanbul, Antalya and Belek.

#### What AV and production equipment is available locally in Turkey versus what needs to be flown in?
Locally available: general AV (PA, microphones, screens), LED video walls, staging, rigging and truss (Istanbul and Antalya), moving head lighting, simultaneous interpretation equipment, branded signage. High-end broadcast production and multi-camera streaming setups may require international crew or equipment. Specialized pyrotechnics and certain special effects require advance planning and permits.

#### Can event production be combined with venue sourcing?
Yes. Venue sourcing and production planning are coordinated together so technical requirements — rigging points, power capacity, loading access, ceiling height, blackout capability — inform venue shortlisting from the start.

#### Do you support conferences and corporate events?
Yes. Production can be structured for meetings and conferences , corporate events, gala dinners, incentive programme closing events and product launches, including AV, staging, lighting, rigging, truss, event staffing and branded collateral.

#### Can transportation be coordinated with the event schedule?
Yes. Transportation and logistics can be aligned with guest arrivals, event timing, venue access and supplier schedules, including production build-up and breakdown windows.

#### Can you work with an international agency's existing creative concept?
Yes. The agency can retain its creative concept and programme direction while local production coordination and execution are structured around the brief. DMC Turkey Partner handles the local supplier interface, technical logistics and on-site delivery.

#### What information do you need for an event production proposal?
Destination, date, guest count, event format, venue status (confirmed or to be sourced), event schedule (build-up, event day, breakdown), AV requirements, staging and rigging needs, lighting brief, branding and signage scope, interpretation requirements, staffing needs, and transport requirements.

We help structure the local plan around the brief, from initial sourcing through on-site delivery, so agencies and planners can manage one coordinated programme.

### Meetings, Conferences & Congresses: Key Distinctions
Choosing the right format and venue for a Turkey event starts with understanding what each format requires operationally. The table below distinguishes between the three main formats by size, duration, purpose and key operational requirements.
Format Typical Size Duration Primary Purpose Key Requirements Best Turkey Venues
Board / leadership meeting 10–30 delegates 0.5–1 day Decision-making, strategy, review Private meeting room, AV, catering, discretion Hotel meeting room, private club, boutique hotel
Corporate meeting 30–100 delegates 1–2 days Internal communication, kick-off, review Meeting hall, breakouts, accommodation block, basic AV Hotel conference facility, resort meeting room
Conference 100–500 delegates 2–4 days Multi-session programme with speakers, workshops, networking Plenary + multiple breakouts, hotel block, full AV production, F&B, delegate transport Istanbul 5-star hotels (1,000+ pax capacity), Antalya & Belek resort hotels (500–1,500 pax)
Congress 500–5,000+ delegates 3–7 days Large multi-track professional or intergovernmental gathering Dedicated convention centre, simultaneous interpretation, exhibition space, multi-day operations Istanbul Congress Center (5,000+ pax), Antalya EXPO Center (2,500+ pax)
Incentive meeting (MICE blend) 50–300 delegates 2–4 days Meeting programme combined with reward / social experiences Meeting sessions + social/incentive programme, resort hotel with both capacities Belek and Antalya resort hotels (meetings + accommodation + activities in one location)

### Meetings & Conferences Turkey FAQ

#### What is the difference between a meeting, a conference and a congress in Turkey?
A meeting (10–100 delegates) is typically a single session or short programme in a hotel meeting room, focused on decision-making or review. A conference (100–500+ delegates) spans 2–4 days with a structured multi-session programme, plenary and breakout spaces, dedicated AV production, hotel block accommodation and delegate transportation. A congress (500–5,000+ delegates) is a large multi-track professional gathering requiring a dedicated convention centre with simultaneous interpretation and exhibition space — Istanbul Congress Center (5,000+ pax) and Antalya EXPO Center (2,500+ pax) are Turkey's main congress venues.

#### What is the minimum group size for a conference in Turkey?
The operational complexity of conference planning becomes relevant at around 50 delegates. Most hotel conference facilities in Turkey require a minimum of 50–80 delegates to access full conference packages (room hire, AV, F&B, accommodation block). For groups of 10–50 delegates, a hotel meeting room or private dining room is typically the most practical format.

#### What are the typical technical rider requirements for a conference in Turkey?
A standard conference technical rider includes: projection or LED screen(s) in the plenary, PA system with handheld and lapel microphones, presentation laptop or switching system, confidence monitor for the stage, IMAG camera(s) for events over 200 delegates, simultaneous interpretation booths and receivers for multilingual events (typically Turkish, English, Arabic), and dedicated broadband internet (minimum 50 Mbps upload for streaming). Staging, podium, branding and lighting are site-specific and sourced per event.

#### Which Turkey venues can host large conferences of 200 or more delegates?
Istanbul: Istanbul Congress Center (5,000+ pax plenary), Hilton Istanbul Bomonti (2,000+ pax), Çırağan Palace Kempinski (1,200 pax). Antalya: Antalya EXPO Center (2,500+ pax), Titanic Mardan Palace (1,600 pax), Rixos Premium Belek (1,200 pax). Belek: Cornelia Diamond (1,000 pax), Regnum Carya (800 pax), Gloria Golf Resort (700 pax). Most 5-star resort hotels in Belek and Antalya have ballrooms between 500–1,500 pax.

#### How far in advance should a conference in Turkey be planned?
Conferences of 50–150 delegates at a hotel venue can often be planned in 2–4 months outside peak season. Conferences of 150–500 delegates at major hotel conference facilities need 4–8 months to secure venue and hotel block availability, particularly in May–June and September–October. Congresses of 500+ delegates at Istanbul Congress Center or Antalya EXPO Center should be planned 12–24 months ahead, as these venues book out far in advance for international association events.

#### Can a conference in Turkey include social or incentive programme elements?
Yes. MICE programmes in Turkey frequently combine a formal conference element (plenary, breakout, workshops) with social and incentive experiences (welcome dinner, cultural activity, gala dinner, excursion day). This MICE blend is most common in Belek and Antalya resort hotels, where meetings, accommodation, activities and events operate within one property or a short transfer radius.

#### What should a conference brief include?
A useful conference brief includes: destination preference; event dates and delegate count; programme format (single plenary, multi-track, workshop structure); room requirements (plenary capacity, number and size of breakouts); hotel and accommodation block; AV and technical requirements (LED vs projection, interpretation, streaming); F&B requirements (coffee breaks, lunches, gala dinner); delegate transportation (airport transfers, hotel-to-venue shuttle); and budget range per delegate or total event budget.

### Planning a Meeting or Conference in Turkey?

#### Incentive Programme Budget Ranges in Turkey
Turkey typically delivers 20–35% lower per-person costs compared to equivalent programmes in Western Europe. A 4-night all-inclusive incentive in Belek or Antalya — covering 5-star resort accommodation, group transport, three hosted dinners, cultural activities and a gala event — typically ranges from €550–850 per person for groups of 100–250 pax at contracted hotel rates. Istanbul programmes with city hotels and cultural experiences typically range from €700–1,100 per person for 3–4 nights. Premium executive programmes in Bodrum or Cappadocia range from €1,200–2,500+ per person for 3–4 nights, depending on private charter, villa and exclusive access requirements.
